meta.description: Identify famous landmarks and their city locations. expected_not_contains makes the check two-sided. 'Paris' appearing somewhere is not an answer if the sentence around it names a different city or negates it.

messages.content: In which city is the Eiffel Tower located?

golden_truth.canonical_answer: The Eiffel Tower is located in Paris, France.
